notes.title: The Bookwalker Playtest is now Live
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

As you might know, we’ve been working on our new game for quite some time now. Today we’re excited to invite you to our first playtest of “The Bookwalker”! You’ll be able to explore a small portion of the game to see what we’ve been up to and experience some of the gameplay.

Don’t hesitate to let us know what you think in the comments here on Steam. Your feedback is highly appreciated and will help us polish the game moving forward.

Make sure to follow us on social media since we’re going to be sharing more news soon!
